assumptions: Earned figures through Day 10 are fixed; only days after Day 10 are projected.
Remaining days of the current week: Sunday = last Saturday × Sunday uplift; Mon–Thu = last Friday × weekday ratio; Saturday = last Friday × 1.4.
Following 10 weeks: each week keeps a fixed share (weekly retention) of the week before, spread evenly across its days.
India gross = India net × 1.195 (worldwide minus overseas over cumulative net on Day 10).
Future overseas = future India net × 0.596 (Day 10 overseas-to-net ratio) × overseas legs.
Festival days 3–6 (Diwali week) inflated Week 1, so Week 1 weekdays are not used to project Week 2 weekdays.
Competition, screen-count loss and a mainland China release are not modelled directly; the scenario spread is the allowance for them.
No mainland China revenue is included. See the China sensitivity model.

assumptions: North America: second-weekend figure $7.5M is a projection until actuals arrive; Mon–Thu after it = weekend × 0.55; later weeks = weekend × 1.55, then shrinking by weekly retention for 10 weeks.
Japan: lifetime = first six days (¥2.7B, Nov 3–8) × multiple. Japanese live-action hits usually run long; Godzilla Minus One finished far above its opening.
Japan is converted at ¥168.5 per USD (implied by Box Office Mojo USD and Deadline JPY figures for the same period; replaced by the ECB rate once fetched).
International excluding Japan: international weekend minus Japan to date ($15.4M, derived) × multiple.
